The '''Predacious blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used around the time of the [[Eternal Empire conquest]].<ref name="KotFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Predacious blaster rifle appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KotFE" /> It was introduced in [[July]] [[2015]] as a reward for the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic#PvP and Warzones|ranked PvP]] Season 6,<ref name="Season 6">{{TORweb|subdomain=forums|url=topic/743805-predacious-season-6-has-begun|text=Predacious Season 6 Has Begun!}}</ref> and made available for players upon the end of the season, on [[October 20]], 2015.<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> The ranked PvP system was eventually removed from the game with the Game Update 7.2, in [[2022]].<ref name="7.2">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20221209|text=PvP Revamp with Game Update 7.2}}</ref>
